title: I can receive Thunderbird message but I cannot send.
creator: HarveyV
content:
Thunderbird cannot send email — Roadrunner account

I use Thunderbird on Windows 11 with a legacy Spectrum/Roadrunner email address (@nycap.rr.com).

The problem started recently. I can receive email normally through Thunderbird, but cannot send.

What I've established:

I can both send and receive successfully through Spectrum Webmail.

Thunderbird's outgoing server is mail.twc.com.

SMTP port is 587.

Connection security is STARTTLS.

Authentication is Normal Password.

Username is my full Roadrunner email address.

Windows PowerShell Test-NetConnection to mail.twc.com on port 587 reports TcpTestSucceeded: True.

Thunderbird's connection test still fails.

Antivirus is McAfee LiveSafe, with Advanced Firewall enabled.

The exact Thunderbird error is:

"Sending of the message failed. The message could not be sent because connecting to Outgoing server (SMTP) mail.twc.com failed."

I'd appreciate help identifying why Thunderbird cannot establish its SMTP connection when Windows can reach the server and Spectrum Webmail works.

title: Folder sorting is missing (A-Z) / Fehlende Sortierung der Ordner
creator: ath1
content:
Hello, I’ve been using Thunderbird for decades. It’s one of the few email programs that can handle large numbers of folders and emails across many accounts without any issues. There’s just one feature I sorely miss: I haven’t found a way to sort the folders alphabetically while the program is running. When you set up a new Thunderbird account or even just a new folder, the subfolders in that folder are usually sorted, but this sorting gets lost over time (you might move them accidentally while scrolling, etc.). Unfortunately, there’s no way to restore the sorting. Or is there? Why not? Can this be changed? Is there a plugin? Thanks!

Best regards, ATH

Hallo, ich nutze seit Jahrzehnten Thunderbird. Es ist eines der Wenigen eMail-Programm, die auch große Mengen von Ordner und eMails über viele Konten klaglos verwalten können. Nur eine Funktion vermisse ich schmerzlich: Ich habe keine Möglichkeit gefunden die Ordner im laufenden Betrieb alphabetisch zu sortieren. Richte man Thunderbird oder auch nur einen Ordner neu ein, werde in diesem Ordner die Unterordner in der Regel zwar sortiert, aber diese Sortierung geht mit der Zeit verloren (man verschiebt sie versehentlich, beim Scrollen etc.). Leider gibt es keine Funktion, dann die Sortierung wieder herzustellen. Oder? Warum nicht? Kann man das ändern? Gibt es ein Plugin? Danke!

MFG ATH

title: New Outlook.com account – SMTP OAuth2 fails with “SmtpClientAuthentication is disabled for the Mailbox”
creator: pl11
content:
Hello,

I recently created a personal Outlook.com account and configured it in Mozilla Thunderbird on Windows 11.

What works:

  • Receiving emails via IMAP in Thunderbird.
  • Sending and receiving emails through Outlook.com webmail.
  • Microsoft OAuth2 authorization completes successfully.

What fails:

Sending emails from Thunderbird consistently fails with an SMTP authentication error.

SMTP configuration:

Server: smtp-mail.outlook.com Port: 587 Connection security: STARTTLS Authentication: OAuth2 Username: user@outlook.com (anonymized)

Exact error from Thunderbird's Error Console:

535 Authentication unsuccessful, SmtpClientAuthentication is disabled for the Mailbox.

Followed by:

Error during AUTH XOAUTH2, sending empty response

500 Unrecognized command 'Length: 7'

Troubleshooting already performed: Verified all IMAP and SMTP settings. Enabled two-step verification on my Microsoft account. Confirmed that the SMTP username matches my Microsoft account's primary alias. Deleted and renewed the stored OAuth2 credentials. Tested both smtp-mail.outlook.com and smtp.office365.com. Temporarily disabled Bitdefender's Thunderbird extension. Confirmed that Thunderbird accepts Microsoft authentication cookies.

None of these steps resolved the issue.

Microsoft Support declined to investigate SMTP AUTH availability for my mailbox and referred me to Mozilla.

I found similar reports, including Mozilla Bugzilla issue #2071567.

Could you confirm whether this is a known limitation affecting newly created Outlook.com accounts and whether a workaround or fix is available?

Thank you.
